patch_selection: Existing spatial quantile regions fixed before model predictions; unchanged
reference: Official automatic RNA/Azimuth silver labels; no manual gold
heldout: No Atera names in audited NuClass TRAIN or CellSTP catalog; full donor/pretraining independence uncertified
coarse_prediction: sum frozen 47-class posterior within fixed groups, then argmax; no organ renormalization
native47_prediction: original 47-class argmax; no group argmax substitution
composition: Prediction and reference both restricted to exactly the same full-resolvable reference cells
maps: All supplied in-image centroids, including unresolved references shown grey; no thinning
contours: Registered provided Atera nuclear polygons, not model-generated segmentation
visual: Actual RGB unchanged in raw panels; H&E alpha 0.38 beneath opaque colored contours/centroids; fixed equal extent
inference: No new neural inference, fit, training or GPU use
averages: Equal-organ mean; only four samples, not 1.4M independent patients
uncertainty: Raw, uncalibrated group confidence; agreement to silver reference, not assay-validated correctness; no threshold chosen for reporting
